applies_why: The judge text treats the cited rows as answered by [CR2] G, which is the answered-verse situation K-G4 says is not counted.
quote: [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge says the rows were answered, K-G4 directs that the verse not be counted as an unanswered witness and does not require a quoted press sentence.
